tools.name: docs_search
tools.description: Search the Flowie Exchange API documentation and return the most relevant pages with their URLs and descriptions. Use this first when you need to find where something is documented.

tools.name: docs_read_page
tools.description: Read a documentation page as markdown. Accepts a full URL from search_docs, or a path such as /reference/ or /guides/send-invoice.

tools.name: docs_list_endpoints
tools.description: List the API's operations (method, path, summary) from the OpenAPI contract, optionally filtered by a substring of the path or summary.

tools.name: docs_get_auth_guide
tools.description: Return the authentication walkthrough for agents: how to get a sandbox key with no signup, how a user hands an agent scoped access, error handling and revocation.

tools.name: sandbox_create_credential
tools.description: Mint a working sandbox API key with no signup and no human in the loop. Returns an apiKey (flw_test_...), an organizationId, a seeded company with a Peppol id, and suggested next steps. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "sandbox_create_credential" references sensitive artifacts (apikey). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Mint a working sandbox API key with no signup and no human in the loop. Returns an apiKey (flw_test_...), an organizationId, a seeded company with a Peppol id, …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: docs_search, docs_read_page · Private data: sandbox_create_credential · Public sink: docs_read_page, sandbox_create_credential.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: docs_search, docs_read_page · Private data: sandbox_create_credential · Public sink: docs_read_page, sandbox_create_credential

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
